final: WITH f AS (SELECT a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type='VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS s, AVG(t.balance) AS b FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), m AS (SELECT AVG(s) AS mu FROM f) SELECT AVG(f.s) AS avg_signed, AVG(f.b) AS avg_balance, AVG(f.s - m.mu) AS avg_excess FROM f, m WHERE f.s > m.mu
